scope: Carrier construction, nesting, boundary dissolution, register lifetime and payload ports
construction_rules: Build operator topology from actual component operations and bound payloads; the supplied glyph sequence is illustrative.
A word supplies nodes. Protocol edges supply reconnection; split/fuse ancestry is checked on those edges.
Compose through available ports. Consume payload source and terminal interfaces and retain its work and interior dyads.
Place payload work on the enclosing arm before its fuse. Defer terminal fixation to the parent fixation after fusion.
Open the region retaining deposits before the region doing work; bank results across reversal and restore them on fusion.
Dissolve matched interior boundaries into the outer boundary while retaining work order, bound payloads, registers and connection identity.
Prepare shared structures at their enclosing lifetime. Keep their state resident and roll back only branch additions.
Connect adjacent forward transformation and reverse verification maps. Compose longer connections from those maps.
Return constraints and checked results through defined ports. Select the first verified closure and retain unfinished arm state.
Retain output inside the vessel until terminal readout; emit source, factors and certificate together.

current_wiring.component_ports: Frames, Square, Admission, Correlation, Masks, Verify in glut_fold::Port::ORDER
current_wiring.construction: glut_carrier assembles the component protocols under GLUT and the skin, consumes their source and terminal interfaces, and binds each trigger by its component slot.
current_wiring.dissolution: Matched interior split/fuse boundaries dissolve. The assembled work and slot bindings retain their order under one enclosing dyad.
current_wiring.state_lifetime: fold::Resident owns source, frame register, square phase, geometry frontier, correlation graph and masks across carrier return passes.
current_wiring.return_edge: CarrierWalk repeats the connected component body inside the same open frame until the verification port completes.
current_wiring.banking: phase_word assigns stable deposit identities to bound register slots and lanes. Repeated passes retain those identities; reversal preserves banked payload references.
current_wiring.verification: The Verify port materializes and checks checkpoint ancestry before CarrierWalk releases the enclosing fuse and fixation.
current_wiring.output: m3mbrain reads the already verified execution and emits source, factors and reentry certificate together.
